def parser(log: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    import re
    results: dict[str, str] = {}

    # JUnit/XML parsing (minimal, regex-based for robustness)
    # Capture testcase names and check for failure/error/skipped tags inside.
    # This is a simplistic parser that works even if XML is embedded in logs.
    testcase_re = re.compile(r"<testcase\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</testcase>", re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    name_attr_re = re.compile(r'\bname="([^"]+)"')
    failure_re = re.compile(r"<(failure|error)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
    skipped_re = re.compile(r"<skipped\b", re.IGNORECASE)

    for m in testcase_re.finditer(log):
        attrs, body = m.groups()
        name_m = name_attr_re.search(attrs)
        if not name_m:
            continue
        name = name_m.group(1).strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        if failure_re.search(body):
            results[name] = "fail"
        elif skipped_re.search(body):
            results[name] = "skip"
        else:
            results[name] = "pass"

    # Regex patterns for line-based parsing
    gtest_status_re = re.compile(
        r'^\s*(?:\d+\s*:)?\s*\[\s*(OK|FAILED|SKIPPED)\s*\]\s+(.+?)(?:\s*\(\s*\d+\s*ms\s*\))?\s*$',
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    gtest_summary_skip_re = re.compile(r'^\s*\d+\s+tests?\b|\btests?\s+from\b', re.IGNORECASE)

    go_test_re = re.compile(r'^\s*---\s+(PASS|FAIL|SKIP):\s+([^\s]+)', re.IGNORECASE)
    pytest_re = re.compile(r'^\s*([^\s:]+::[^\s]+)\s+(PASSED|FAILED|SKIPPED|XFAIL|XPASS|ERROR)\b', re.IGNORECASE)
    unittest_re = re.compile(r'^\s*([^\s]+)\s*\.\.\.\s*(ok|FAIL|ERROR|skipped)\b', re.IGNORECASE)

    for line in log.splitlines():
        # GTest-style lines
        m = gtest_status_re.match(line)
        if m:
            status_raw, name = m.groups()
            name = name.strip()
            # Skip suite summaries like "[  PASSED  ] 28 tests."
            if gtest_summary_skip_re.search(name):
                continue
            status_raw = status_raw.upper()
            if status_raw == "OK":
                status = "pass"
            elif status_raw == "SKIPPED":
                status = "skip"
            else:
                status = "fail"
            results[name] = status
            continue

        # Go test lines
        m = go_test_re.match(line)
        if m:
            status_raw, name = m.groups()
            status_raw = status_raw.upper()
            status = "pass" if status_raw == "PASS" else "skip" if status_raw == "SKIP" else "fail"
            results[name] = status
            continue

        # Pytest lines
        m = pytest_re.match(line)
        if m:
            name, status_raw = m.groups()
            status_raw = status_raw.upper()
            if status_raw in {"PASSED", "XPASS"}:
                status = "pass"
            elif status_raw in {"SKIPPED", "XFAIL"}:
                status = "skip"
            else:
                status = "fail"
            results[name] = status
            continue

        # Unittest lines
        m = unittest_re.match(line)
        if m:
            name, status_raw = m.groups()
            status_raw = status_raw.lower()
            if status_raw == "ok":
                status = "pass"
            elif status_raw == "skipped":
                status = "skip"
            else:
                status = "fail"
            results[name] = status
            continue

    return results
